description: Interpretive / argument-based fields (philosophy, political theory, literary criticism, history of science). Reading + claim-counter-claim > drill.

phases.label: Context
phases.tone: the historical / intellectual moment; what came before; what was at stake

phases.label: Claims
phases.tone: the central arguments + their named proponents; original sources by name

phases.label: Counter-claims
phases.tone: the strongest objections + who made them; productive disagreements

phases.label: Frontier
phases.tone: current debates + 2025-2026 papers reviving / refuting old positions

phases.label: Synthesis
phases.tone: the learner's own argued essay defending a specific position
